findings.claim: The five description-text requirements are enumerated as one long prose paragraph, which is harder to scan than a bulleted list would be.
The never-shipped-field rule is packed into a single sentence; adding a clause break after "in place:" would improve readability without changing its meaning.

This passage runs three separate ideas together (why route services can't sit under domain/, the follow-up-identification bar, and parity with reviewing.md), and splitting it into separate sentences would ease first-read comprehension.
